difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a finite morphism f : X -> S and a quasi-coherent F on X, one has WeakAss(f_*F) = f(WeakAss(F)) (source lines 879-884). The proof passes to the affine case, so that f comes from a finite ring map A -> B and F from a B-module M, identifies the weakly associated points of F with the weakly associated primes of M and those of f_*F with the weakly associated primes of M viewed as an A-module (the affine-open lemma), and concludes by the corresponding algebra statement for finite ring maps.
